description: This file defines a React component named 'Square' used as a single cell in a Tic Tac Toe game. It includes accessibility features, SVG icons for moves, and handles keyboard events.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: React functional component representing a single Tic Tac Toe board cell with icon display and keyboard support.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events ('Enter' or space) to trigger the onClick function if the component is enabled.

methods.name: renderIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG icon element corresponding to the current value ('X' or 'O') for rendering inside the button.
